comment: The ecolog window («Науковий термінал», the Scientists' lab terminal): every picture the mockup draws with CSS.
Sizes are layout units; drawn at 1.5 px per unit. White shapes are tinted in the game (the layout's color or SetColor);
the textures with their own colours (tree_glow, fog_stripes) are shown with color 1 1 1 1.
The rules are the mockup's own CSS (body[data-f=ecolog] and the base it builds on), lifted into ecolog.css.
hex_sel is not in the mockup: it underlines the selected node's name, the game rings the hexagon instead (the task's brief).
branch_next is not in the mockup either (one branch per faction there): the mark before the branch name when there are several.
fog_stripes and dash are pixel tiles: the game repeats a picture shown without stretching at one texel per screen
pixel, so they are drawn at exactly 32 and 16 pixels (w x 1.5 = size).
